name: AMD Radeon RX 9070 XT product specifications page
notes: Vendor primary spec page. No publication date is printed on the page, so published is null rather than guessed. Verbatim fields used: Board Type Desktop, Additional Power Connector 2x8-Pin, Compute Units 64, Boost Frequency Up to 2970 MHz, Game Frequency 2400 MHz, Ray Accelerators 64, AI Accelerators 128, Stream Processors 4096, ROPs 128, Transistor Count 53.9 B, Peak Pixel Fill-Rate Up to 380.2 GP/s, Peak Single Precision (FP32 Vector) Performance 48.7 TFLOPs, Peak Half Precision (FP16 Vector) Performance 48.7 TFLOPs, Peak Half Precision (FP16 Matrix) Performance 195 TFLOPs, Peak Half Precision (FP16 Matrix) Performance with Structured Sparsity 389 TFLOPs, Peak 8-bit Precision (FP8 Matrix) Performance (E5M2, E4M3) 389 TFLOPs, Peak 8-bit Precision (FP8 Matrix) Performance with Structured Sparsity (E5M2, E4M3) 779 TFLOPs, Peak 8-bit Precision (INT8 Matrix) Performance 389 TOPs, Peak 8-bit Precision (INT8 Matrix) Performance with Structured Sparsity 779 TOPs, Peak 4-bit Precision (INT4 Matrix) Performance 779 TOPs, Peak 4-bit Precision (INT4 Matrix) Performance with Structured Sparsity 1557 TOPs, Typical Board Power (Desktop) 304W, Minimum PSU Recommendation 750W, GPU Memory: AMD Infinity Cache Technology 64 MB, Memory Speed Up to 20 Gbps, Max Memory Size 16 GB, Memory Type GDDR6, Memory Interface 256-bit, Memory Bandwidth Up to 640 GB/s, Bus Type PCIe 5.0 x16, Connectivity DisplayPort 2.1a / HDMI 2.1b, TPP 3114, TPP Density 9.06. The page carries the caption 'Artist render. Not available for purchase.' on the hero image. Note the page never states the architecture generation or the process node; those come from acc-fill-amd-rdna-architecture-page. Unlike the 7900 XTX page, this one DOES print a Memory Interface row. Accessed 2026-10-03.
